From t=8m on, price chopped and gave back the gain, round-tripping to -14.5pt at t=14m before recovering slightly to -9.5pt at the final frame -- concerning but never showed a clean, sustained against-fire streak or an accelerating adverse leg (ER10 stayed low/choppy, PROPP flipped with/against repeatedly rather than committing one direction), so I judged it unresolved chop rather than confirmed wrong-direction and never got a clean bail signal. Next time I'd watch for a sustained run of against-fires (2+ consecutive) plus a leg giveback that keeps climbing without a with-fire counter-response as the actual wrong-direction confirmation, rather than reacting to single red frames.
